newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices slide on fresh stock arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices slide on fresh stock arrivals.

text.p: Sugar prices suffered a fresh setback on Monday, dealers said.
"Consumer demand was lower than expected, while fresh arrivals pulled down prices," said a dealer.

Ready delivery Sugar S-30 slid by 5/10 rupees to 1,225/1,260 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell 13 rupees to 1,255/1,305 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery was also quoted by 10/20 rupees at 1,150/1,170 rupees per quintal.
"Sentiments at the close remained subdued but traders were expecting fresh buying support in the coming days. Market may fluctuate in a narrow range," one broker said.
